newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 27.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 27.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were reported open Thursday, Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.

Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz and Nautla were shut to smaller tourism and fishing boats, the ministry said. It advised smaller craft against sailing in the coast of the Gulf of Mexico and the west coast of the Baja California peninsula because of high wind speeds and waves.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Lower temperatures and possible rains along northern coast, where winds reported at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) and waves five to seven feet high.

Light cold front with lower temperatures, clouds and winds along coasts of Tamaulipas, Veracruz and the Campeche Sound at 15 to 20 knots. Conditions expected to slightly worsen later in the day, moving southeast along the gulf.
Hot and partly cloudy with moderate southeast winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
